highlights: The latest AI news highlights a strong focus on enhancing agent capabilities, with new frameworks and memory systems emerging to simplify development and improve governance.
Significant model releases include open-weights safety classifiers and on-device agentic models, pushing performance and accessibility boundaries.

Developer tools are expanding rapidly, offering specialized browsers for agents and advanced APIs for building robust, production-ready AI applications, alongside a focus on foundational research and strategic vision.

agents.title: NVIDIA AI Releases NOOA: Object-Oriented Python Framework for Agents
agents.summary: NVIDIA Labs has open-sourced NOOA, a model-agnostic Python framework that collapses AI agent development into a single Python class, streamlining the creation of actions, state, and prompts.

agents.title: Tencent Cloud Open-Sources TencentDB Agent Memory v2.0
agents.summary: Tencent Cloud released TencentDB Agent Memory v2.0, a self-hosted, MIT-licensed team-level memory hub that transforms conversations and code into governed, reusable assets for AI coding agents, enhancing asset visibility and version control.

agents.title: Prime Intellect Releases Prime Agent: Open-Source RLM Harness
agents.summary: Prime Intellect has open-sourced Prime Agent, a coding and research harness built on a Recursive Language Model (RLM) where sub-agents are function calls within a persistent IPython kernel, allowing agents to edit their own prompts and skills mid-run.

models.title: Mistral AI Releases Shieldstral 1.0 3B: Open-Weights Safety Classifier
models.summary: Mistral AI introduced Shieldstral 1.0 3B, an open-weights, policy-adaptive multimodal safety classifier that offers content moderation as a yes/no question, matching models seven times its size in performance while remaining compact for on-device deployment.

models.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-2.6B: On-Device Agentic Model
models.summary: Liquid AI unveiled LFM2.5-2.6B, an open-weights, agentic model designed for on-device execution, featuring 128K context, tool calling, and multi-step task completion with high decoding speeds in a small memory footprint.

models.title: OpenAI Improves GPT‑5.6 Sol and Expands GPT-5.6 Luna Access
models.summary: OpenAI announced improvements to GPT-5.6 Sol in ChatGPT, enhancing its accuracy and consistency, and expanded access to the powerful GPT-5.6 Luna for all free users, making advanced AI more widely available.

tools.title: Cloudflare Introduces Kitesurf: Agent-First Web Browser
tools.summary: Cloudflare released Kitesurf, a stateless, agent-first web browser running entirely in V8 Isolates on Cloudflare Workers, optimized for machine-readable content and scalability with significantly lower CPU and memory usage than Chromium.

tools.title: Google Expands Gemini API Managed Agents with 3.6 Flash, Hooks
tools.summary: Google announced new capabilities for Managed Agents in the Gemini API, including support for Gemini 3.6 Flash and custom hooks, enabling developers to build more reliable and production-ready AI agents with enhanced flexibility.

tools.title: OpenAI's Realtime System for Responsive Voice AI (GPT-Live)
tools.summary: OpenAI detailed the engineering behind GPT-Live, a real-time system for continuous voice interaction that uses a turnless speech model and low-latency architecture, enabling faster and more natural AI conversations.

companies.title: OpenAI Responds to Critical Cyber Capabilities Frontier
companies.summary: OpenAI shared preliminary cybersecurity evaluations for Astra and outlined proactive steps to strengthen safeguards and security controls, addressing the evolving landscape of advanced AI cyber capabilities.

companies.title: OpenAI Reports Ten Advances in Math and Theoretical Computer Science
companies.summary: OpenAI announced new research results on long-standing open problems in mathematics and theoretical computer science, including advancements in geometry, cryptography, and complexity, showcasing foundational scientific progress.

companies.title: OpenAI Details 'Building Abundant Intelligence' Strategy
companies.summary: OpenAI described its full-stack approach to 'building abundant intelligence,' focusing on making advanced AI more capable, affordable, and widely useful across various applications and societal needs.

learning.title: Google's 353,000-Person AI Agents Intensive Course Recap
learning.summary: Google recapped its highly successful, no-cost AI Agents Intensive on Kaggle, which empowered 353,000 learners to build and deploy the next generation of AI agents, highlighting a massive global upskilling effort.

learning.title: Designing Scalable Interactive Visualizations with Reflex XY
learning.summary: A comprehensive tutorial guides through using the Reflex XY Python library to build high-performance, interactive charts capable of handling million-point datasets, real-time streaming, and creating custom visual plugins.

learning.title: Building a Multimodal RAG Pipeline with NVIDIA NeMo Retriever
learning.summary: This tutorial details constructing an advanced multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline using NVIDIA NeMo Retriever, hosted NIMs, LanceDB, and grounded generation techniques for enhanced AI applications.
